hold_reason: Alpha Co's refund for order 204 (11000 cents, customer birch) failed with a disk I/O error after 3 attempts and was never recorded. The refunds table correctly lacks it, but net_balance for birch will not include it, so paying birch would overpay by 11000 cents. No payouts have been recorded. Please re-apply the order 204 refund (or confirm it should be dropped) and then resume the batch.
